output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order FROM marts.dim_customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marts.fct_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.is_revenue)
output.explanation: Counts customer accounts that have no order with is_revenue = true (status 'completed'). This includes customers who never ordered and those whose orders were all cancelled, returned or still open.
